{{Top|leg}}
The '''Republic Sector''' was a sector of the [[City/Legends|city]] [[Locus (settlement)|Locus]], on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Nyriaan/Legends|Nyriaan]]. It was considered to be the most recognizable part of Locus and changed hands a number of times throughout Nyriaan's history. The services within the sector were sporadic and unreliable, while security was either lax or heavy-handed.
